Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses TAP-tag affinity purification (AP-MS) to analyze the composition of pre-40S ribosomal particles. Quantification is label-free (LFQ) using iBAQ for some analyses.

scope: To purify pre-ribosomal particles, the protocol described in was adapted as follows: expression of N-terminally HASt-tagged or C-terminally StHA-tagged bait proteins in stable HEK293 cells was induced with tetracycline
the lysate was incubated with EZview Red Anti-HA Affinity Gel (Sigma-Aldrich) for 2 hr in an overhead shaker
For subsequent analyses by silver staining, western blotting, and mass spectrometry, beads were washed three times with TAP buffer and bound material was eluted with SDS sample buffer.
Protein and RNA composition of the affinity-purified complexes, hereafter called RIO1(kd)-StHA pre-40S particles, were analyzed using SDS–PAGE, northern blot, and bottom-up proteomics

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by mass spectrometry consisted of pre-40S ribosomal particles affinity-purified using tagged RIO1 as bait via TAP purification.

Comparative proteomics analyses of RIO1(kd)-StHA-associated pre-40S particles in the absence or presence of RPS26 confirmed that no other RPS was lost upon RPS26 depletion

differential: analysis of RIO1(kd)-StHA pre-40S particle composition upon RPS26 depletion
after log2-transformation of the data, an unpaired two-tailed Student’s t-test was performed

search_parameters: Protein modifications were fixed carbamidomethylation of cysteines, variable phosphorylation of serine, threonine and tyrosine, variable oxidation of methionine, variable acetylation of protein N-terminus.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The study includes two distinct MS analyses: a one-shot composition analysis of RIO1(kd)-StHA particles and a comparative LFQ analysis between control and RPS26-depleted cells. The differential analysis is a straightforward case-control comparison at the protein level.
